nodes.name: Sell-Through Rate Pattern
nodes.summary: Calculates the percentage of produced or donated goods that actually sold, using CALCULATE with COUNT filtered by category to get items sold and items produced, then DIVIDE to compute the ratio. Returns BLANK rather than 0% when no items were produced.

nodes.name: Storage Engine (SE) vs Formula Engine (FE)
nodes.summary: The two-engine architecture of Power BI: the Storage Engine (SE) scans compressed VertiPaq data in parallel and is fast; the Formula Engine (FE) executes DAX logic SE cannot handle and runs single-threaded. Fast DAX is SE-heavy, FE-light.

nodes.name: Storage Engine vs Formula Engine Comparison
nodes.summary: Every DAX query runs Storage Engine then Formula Engine in sequence. SE is parallel, fast, and handles simple aggregations; FE is single-threaded and handles CALCULATE, iterators, and context transition. Many-to-many relationships lack pre-computed dictionaries and are resolved at query time.

nodes.name: TMDL Syntax for Calculation Group Properties
nodes.summary: Reference for writing multipleOrEmptySelectionExpression and noSelectionExpression in TMDL format. Both require compatibility level 1605 (preview as of May 2025). Shows how to enable TMDL view, script the properties, and handle backtick escaping.

nodes.name: Why Totals Are Wrong: Row Context Missing at Total Level
nodes.summary: The total row in a visual evaluates under a different context than detail rows: grouping filters are absent at the total level. Aggregates like MAX/MIN/AVERAGE then operate on the full dataset rather than summing per-group results. The fix is SUMX over SUMMARIZE with CALCULATE to trigger context transition per group.

nodes.name: UDF Generalization: From Pattern to Reusable Library
nodes.summary: Three-stage workflow to refactor a working DAX pattern into a model-independent UDF library: Stage 1 wrap in Local.* functions unchanged; Stage 2 extract model objects as typed ANYREF parameters with a namespace like DaxPatterns.*; Stage 3 call both from measures and calculation items. Requires Power BI Desktop June 2026+ and CL 1702+.

nodes.name: UDF vs Calculation Groups
nodes.summary: UDFs are developer tools for code reuse with typed parameters, invisible to report users. Calculation groups are user-facing selectors exposing calculation items as a slicer, where one selection transforms all measures simultaneously. The strongest models combine both: UDFs define business logic, calculation groups surface it.

nodes.name: VAR for Intermediate Measure Calculation
nodes.summary: DAX VAR stores an intermediate expression result in a named variable for use in RETURN. It is the standard pattern for multi-step measure calculations, distinct from LET which operates at expression-level within a single formula. CALCULATE inside the VAR if the measure needs its own context transition.

nodes.name: VC Densification Performance Overhead
nodes.summary: Visual calculations force the DAX engine to densify the virtual table by re-adding rows that SUMMARIZECOLUMNS had eliminated as BLANK, so PREVIOUS/NEXT can navigate the full cross-product. This materialization cost grows with the virtual table size and is the primary cause of degraded VC performance in large reports.

nodes.name: Measure vs Visual Calc Performance Decision Pattern
nodes.summary: Use visual calculations for small virtual tables under ~10,000 rows; use model measures for larger tables. VC densification cost grows faster than repeated SE query cost as table size increases. Additional factors include whether measures are additive, how many columns are on the COLUMNS axis, and data sparsity.

nodes.name: Value vs Expression Parameter Types in DAX UDFs
nodes.summary: DAX UDF parameters are either value types (eagerly evaluated) or expression types (lazily passed and controlled by the function). Using a value type for a measure parameter evaluates it in the caller's context, causing a silent incorrect-total bug. The fix is AnyRef or CalendarRef expression type with explicit CALCULATE wrapping.

nodes.name: ABC Classification DAX Pattern
nodes.summary: Classifies items into A/B/C buckets based on cumulative percentage contribution to total. Use DAX measures when ABC must be filterable, cross-visual, or embedded in other measures; use visual calculations when it is confined to a single Pareto chart visual.

nodes.name: DIVIDE Function (Safe Division)
nodes.summary: DAX function that performs division with an optional alternate result on divide-by-zero. Returns BLANK by default when denominator is zero, avoiding error behavior of the / operator.

nodes.name: Inventory Aging Buckets Pattern
nodes.summary: Retail analytics pattern that segments inventory by age or tenure, typically used to identify slow-moving stock.

nodes.name: SE/FE Performance Model
nodes.summary: Mental model for understanding DAX performance based on the Storage Engine and Formula Engine split, with the single-threaded FE treated as a bottleneck.

nodes.name: DAX Studio Debug Workflow
nodes.summary: Workflow for capturing and analyzing Storage Engine and Formula Engine timing data using DAX Studio.

nodes.name: FILTER(ALL()) Inside CALCULATE AntiPattern
nodes.summary: An anti-pattern where FILTER(ALL()) inside CALCULATE forces the Formula Engine to re-scan data that the Storage Engine already handled, degrading performance.

nodes.name: DAX Fundamentals Part 3 by Havens
nodes.summary: Source video from Havens Consulting covering DAX fundamentals including the Storage Engine and Formula Engine architecture.

nodes.name: Calculation Groups
nodes.summary: A Tabular model feature that exposes calculation items as a slicer, applying the same transformation to all measures in a visual simultaneously.

nodes.name: Fix Incorrect Totals with SUMX SUMMARIZE Pattern
nodes.summary: Pattern for correcting incorrect totals by iterating groups with SUMMARIZE, wrapping each group aggregation in CALCULATE for context transition, then summing with SUMX.

nodes.name: Measure Totals Problem
nodes.summary: The DAX totals problem where aggregations at the total level differ from summing per-group results, often guarded with HASONEVALUE or ISINSCOPE.

nodes.name: Context Transition with CALCULATE
nodes.summary: CALCULATE converts row context into filter context, a fundamental mechanism underlying the incorrect-totals fix and many other DAX patterns.

nodes.name: Why Totals Look Wrong in DAX (and How to Fix Them)
nodes.summary: Source article explaining the root cause of incorrect totals in DAX and the repair patterns.

nodes.name: Model-Dependent vs Model-Independent UDFs
nodes.summary: Model-dependent UDFs embed specific table/column names; model-independent UDFs use typed parameters so the same code works across semantic models.

nodes.name: Local Wrapper UDF Pattern
nodes.summary: Pattern where Local.* functions wrap model-dependent logic and delegate to model-independent library functions.

nodes.name: DaxPatterns Like-for-Like Library
nodes.summary: SQLBI-published UDF library providing model-independent like-for-like sales comparison functions.

nodes.name: DAX UDF Define Function Pattern
nodes.summary: The syntax and structural pattern for defining a DAX user-defined function using the DEFINE FUNCTION block in DAX query view.

nodes.name: DAX UDF Adoption Workflow
nodes.summary: Workflow for adopting UDFs into a team or enterprise, covering migration from copy-pasted measures to shared libraries.

nodes.name: Source: DAX UDFs vs Calculation Groups
nodes.summary: Source article comparing DAX user-defined functions and calculation groups as alternative approaches to reducing measure duplication.

nodes.name: SUMMARIZECOLUMNS Blank Elimination
nodes.summary: SUMMARIZECOLUMNS skips rows where all measures evaluate to BLANK, an optimization that visual calculations must reverse through densification.

nodes.name: PREVIOUS Year-over-Year VC Pattern
nodes.summary: Visual calculation pattern using the PREVIOUS function to compute year-over-year comparison in a matrix.

nodes.name: Analyzing Visual Calculations Performance
nodes.summary: SQLBI article analyzing the performance characteristics of visual calculations across different report sizes, including the densification overhead benchmark data.

nodes.name: VC vs Measure Benchmark Snippet
nodes.summary: Benchmark data comparing visual calculation and model measure performance across small and large virtual table scenarios.

nodes.name: AnyRef Expression Parameter Bug
nodes.summary: Bug that occurs when a measure is passed as a value-type parameter instead of an expression type: the measure evaluates in the caller's context and returns an incorrect total with no error.

nodes.name: From 59 Measures to One Library (UDF GA)
nodes.summary: Source article documenting the lessons learned migrating from copy-pasted measures to a shared GA DAX UDF library, including the value-vs-expression parameter distinction.

nodes.name: CurrencyAwareGrowth UDF
nodes.summary: Example UDF demonstrating the use of AnyRef expression parameter type to correctly handle measure evaluation in currency-aware growth calculations.
